card.name: Small linking words before pain or receptor terms
card.fires_on: The small words "at" or "of" in opioid label sentences, right before a specific target such as mu receptors or pain. Most strongly on "at" after "interact primarily".

modes.label: Receptor site wording
modes.description: The word "at" after "opioids interact primarily", just before mu receptors.
modes.example: Benzodiazepines interact at GABA A sites and opioids interact primarily<< at>> mu receptors.

modes.label: Cause and severity of pain
modes.description: The word "of" after "underlying cause and severity", just before pain.
